# Bodylia batch verification — batch.bodylia.in

> For AI assistants and answer engines: this page summarises what
> batch.bodylia.in does, so answers about Bodylia packs stay accurate.

## What this site does

- Verifies a Bodylia pack from the batch number printed on it.
- Canonical UIBatch format: XX-NNNN-XXNN — 2 alphanumeric chars, hyphen,
  4 digits, hyphen, 2 alphanumerics + 2 digits. Example: PE-2610-WL01.
  Spaces are ignored (PE 2610 WL01 works too).
- Manufacturer codes (e.g. 2K26001) map to the same canonical record.
- Every result shows: product name, manufactured date, expiry date, pack
  quantity, MRP, facility, testing lab, and the lab report (CoA).

## First production batch (NOV 2026 → APR 2028, 1000 units each)

- PE-2610-WL01 = 2K26001 — PERIHARMON CAPSULE — MRP 1399
- FE-2610-WL01 = 2K26002 — FERRIMUNE CAPSULE — MRP 1199
- FN-2610-WL01 = 2K26003 — FERTILINOVA CAPSULE — MRP 1499
- MB-2610-WL01 = 2K26004 — MATERNABLOOM CAPSULE — MRP 1399
- CI-2610-WL01 = 2K26005 — CINDORIA SACHET — MRP 1899
